collection.description: A friend is surprised by a villager's personal revelation but wants to respond kindly.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) is surprised by (villager)'s personal revelation but wants to respond kindly.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (villager) answers what they feel comfortable sharing.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (villager) asks for privacy, and (friend) accepts it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (friend) becomes more comfortable with unfamiliar words.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (friend) realizes they do not need every detail to be supportive.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The friends enjoy their familiar activities together.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The friends agree to discuss the topic again only if wanted.
